messages:
anya: Kate (auditor) asked for a compact handoff for INC-2026-0720. Needed: KMS key policy snapshot, CloudTrail entries for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, STS AssumeRole correlation, and a signed manifest. Who can take this?

evidence-bot: Playbook: include exported_by, file->sha256 mapping, presign creator + CloudTrail PutObject event, GPG detached signature, time window, and control_map (SOC2 CC6.2, ISO27001 A.9.2.1). See https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/export-playbook

ben: I can assemble. Quick question: auditor wants principal delegation timeline 1 do you want a CSV + GraphML access graph?

auditor-kate: Yes please both CSV and GraphML for the access graph. Also include any PutKeyPolicy events +/-24h and list-grants output. Time window: 2026-06-01T22:00:00Z - 2026-06-02T02:00:00Z.

anya: Plan: 1) export CloudTrail filters for EventName in [Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey,PutKeyPolicy,AssumeRole] 2) get-key-policy + describe-key + list-grants 3) dump IAM role->principal mapping and run tools/iam_graph.py -> .graphml + .csv 4) collect kube RoleBinding diffs and kube-audit snippets 5) tarball + sha256 + gpg detach-sign, upload to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0720/ with S3 Object Lock, record sts:GetCallerIdentity before presign.

ben: Running commands now (abbrev):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time "2026-06-01T22:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-06-02T02:00:00Z" > ct_encrypt.json
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/99aa88bb --policy-name default > key_policy.json
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/99aa88bb > kms_grants.json
python tools/iam_graph.py --keys key_arns.txt --output inc0720_access.graphml --csv inc0720_access.csv
kubectl get rolebinding -A -o yaml > all_rolebindings.yaml
```

oncall: When uploading, call sts:GetCallerIdentity and include that output in manifest. Set Object Lock retention 30d and tag evidence:INC-2026-0720. Keep CloudTrail S3 object keys referenced in manifest for traceability.

ben: Packaging:
```
tar czf inc0720_evidence_v1.tar.gz ct_*.json key_policy.json kms_grants.json all_rolebindings.yaml inc0720_access.graphml inc0720_access.csv kube-audit.json timeline.md
sha256sum inc0720_evidence_v1.tar.gz > inc0720.sha256
gpg --output inc0720.sig --detach-sign --local-user compliance@redwood-internal inc0720_evidence_v1.tar.gz
```

ben: Uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0720/ with object-lock enabled and created a 7d presign (logged). I captured sts:GetCallerIdentity and saved presign_identity.json. Manifest summary (short): files: [ct_encrypt.json, ct_decrypt.json, ct_assumerole.json, key_policy.json, kms_grants.json, inc0720_access.graphml, inc0720_access.csv, all_rolebindings.yaml, kube-audit.json, timeline.md, inc0720_evidence_v1.tar.gz, inc0720.sha256, inc0720.sig]; exported_by: ben@redwood.com; exported_at: 2026-06-02T06:15:30Z; presign_creator: ben@redwood.com; presign_created_at: 2026-06-02T06:16:05Z; control_map: ["SOC2 CC6.2","ISO27001 A.9.2.1"]; gpg_fingerprint: "1234ABCD5678EF90"

auditor-kate: Received the bundle. I'll validate sha256 + GPG sig and check graph outputs. If we need raw CloudTrail S3 objects or additional kube-audit retention, I'll request. Thanks for the fast turnaround :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the evidence tracker and prepare a short narrative correlating the RoleBinding change at 2026-06-02T00:12:00Z with KMS events. Do not paste presigned URL here.

evidence-bot: Evidence package created: INC-2026-0720/evidence-v1. Follow playbook for handoff.
